description: Exact public UkisAI Swift 1.5 derivative of Qwen3.8 Flash Next in NVFP4 (FP4 routed experts, BF16 everywhere else, BF16 PLE n-gram table, 186.4 GB), reasoning-efficient (upstream claim: 63.4 percent fewer thinking tokens). The Swift contribution is under the Swift Open License v1.0 (free up to US$1M gross annual revenue, otherwise a separate Swift Enterprise License); the Qwen3.8 Flash Next base terms (Qwen Community License 1.0: attribution above 100M MAU or US$20M monthly revenue, separate licence for Model-as-a-Service or AI Work Assistant businesses) still apply. The checkpoint carries a vision tower that the TensorFold CUDA route does not read.
